contract: Review the complete supplied modules and traced callers. Report only material defects supported by source. Temporal preference uses the last N days, including explicit zero and no future boost. include_unvalidated:false excludes unvalidated incidents in standard and indexed retrieval, even at zero similarity threshold. Unreadable/invalid corpus records must be distinguished from an empty inspected corpus while retaining usable records. Preserve pattern-first retrieval, existing valid records, explicit configuration and bounded result budgets. Treat ranking scores as weighted ranks, never calibrated repair confidence. Dependencies not shown are ordinary boundaries; mark missing evidence and do not invent findings. No execution or production claims.
limits: Two historical states of one repository, not independent repositories or unlabeled production incidents.
Review rework measures model revision effort; human effort and production recurrence remain unmeasured.
Historical good state is a protected control for named defect classes, not certified globally defect-free.
